title: worker-owned MSE with MediaSourceHandle

definition.title: worker-owned MSE with MediaSourceHandle
definition.source_excerpt: The environment reports MediaSource.canConstructInDedicatedWorker === true. A worker successfully created a MediaSource and transferred its handle to the main thread. However, attaching that handle to a video on the opaque about:blank/set_content lab page produced media error 4 and the worker never received sourceopen. A follow-on attempt to establish an intercepted secure HTTPS document was blocked by the environment's navigation administrator. No browser restriction was bypassed. Verdict: BLOCKED, not failed. The worker parser/append path was never reached, so this run says nothing negative about worker-owned MSE itself.
